doc: SKÅDIS roll holder for a cloth roll, mm. Axes: X along the roll, Y out of the board (board front face Y = 0), Z up; the top tab of the left bracket sits in the slot at X = 0, Z = 0.

span_cols.doc: slot columns between the brackets (x pitch): 8 = 320 mm, fits every board

axis_y.doc: roll axis distance from the board front face

axis_z.doc: roll axis height relative to the top tab's slot centre

tab_rows.doc: hook tabs per bracket, one slot column, 40 mm apart

plate_bottom.doc: back plate bottom (Z); bears on the board

window_margin.doc: frame width around the arm window

hub_len.doc: hub length (X), from the inner face outwards

shaft_d.doc: plug shaft diameter (bearing and core section)

core_len.doc: plug shaft length beyond the bracket's inner face (into the core)

plug_hollow_d.doc: hollow plug shaft, closed by the knob (0 = solid; hollow prints slower with 2 perimeters)

lug_span.doc: angular span of a bayonet lug arm (deg)

lug_r0.doc: lug arm inner radius (1 mm free gap to the shaft for flexing)

lug_h.doc: lug height (axial) at its outer radius; its back is a 45 deg cone

groove_r.doc: radius of the hub's axial entry grooves

recess_r.doc: radius of the hub recess the lugs turn into

lock_turn.doc: quarter turn to lock (deg, clockwise seen from the knob)

detent_interf.doc: detent bump overlap with the recess wall (click strength)

brake_interf.doc: brake pad overlap with the core wall (radius); 0 = no brake, the core runs loose on the plug (test 2026-11: 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 were all too tight)

brake_len.doc: axial length of the brake springs at the shaft tip

play.doc: axial play of the bayonet (lug to recess ceiling, knob to hub)
